llm_response.reason: The website displays unusually steep discounts on high-value branded goods, lists a suspiciously large variety of product categories uncommon to genuine small retailers, and does not provide clear business authentication details (no verifiable address, contact number, or business credentials). Privacy policy is vague, and company name listed cannot be authenticated. These fulfill several classic scam signals (unusually low price, non-existent/misrepresented company, handling different products, ambiguous privacy, and inappropriate contact info).
